message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "prioritize_visual_inspection_over_automated_tools_for_pathology", "description": "When automated chest X-ray analysis tools return non-specific, negative, or contradictory findings despite clear visual pathology, prioritize direct visual inspection of the original image pixels.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable when interpreting medical imaging (specifically chest X-rays) where automated diagnostic aids (classifiers or report generators) fail to identify obvious morphological abnormalities or provide conflicting results.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` or `chest_xray_report_generator` returns negative, non-specific, or contradictory findings for an image with suspected pathology: (1) disregard the automated output as potentially unreliable; (2) perform direct visual inspection of the original image pixels to identify key morphological features (e.g., size, distribution, margins); (3) base the differential diagnosis on these visually confirmed features rather than the tool outputs."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
